subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept client-capability-gated tool availability and a Canvas-owned `show_widget` web-chat widget surface as the product/API direction for this issue?
rationale: The request creates a plugin-visible tool API and a scripted HTML/SVG sandbox rendering surface; source review can confirm implementation presence, but product and security ownership must come from maintainers.

options.title: Review Linked PR As The Candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the implementation candidate and land it only after API, upgrade, and sandbox-security review.

options.title: Narrow The API First
options.body: Keep the inline-widget goal but redesign the capability contract before exposing it to plugin authors.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widget Surface
options.body: Leave the issue open or close the PR if maintainers want this to remain an external or plugin experiment for now.

recommendation.title: Review Linked PR As The Candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the implementation candidate and land it only after API, upgrade, and sandbox-security review.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest recent Canvas/plugin history signal and authored the open candidate implementation.
